title: Tests posting claude_model_access must authenticate as a Desktop OAuth client
answers: Why does my test for claude_model_access return 400?
How do I test own-subscription task run creation?
body:
Tests that send `claude_model_access` (e.g. `own-subscription` in run or resume flows) must use an OAuth client with a Desktop client id. Plain `self.client` (session auth) is now rejected.
- In `products/tasks/backend/tests/test_api.py`, use `self._oauth_client(ARRAY_APP_CLIENT_ID_DEV).post(...)`. See `test_run_endpoint_persists_agent_toggle` and `test_resume_requires_explicit_claude_billing_choice`.
- Serializer-level tests in `products/tasks/backend/tests/test_presentation_serializers.py` (`test_subscription_checks_oauth_origin`) build `OAuthAccessTokenAuthentication` with an `OAuthAccessToken` that sets `source_refresh_token_id`. This makes `is_interactive_desktop_grant` pass. Without it the token isn't treated as an interactive Desktop grant.
- Negative cases to cover: personal API key, session, mobile and sandbox callers, all expecting a 400 with `attr == "claude_model_access"` and no TaskRun created.
